notes.title: Game Saving is Here!
notes.content:
Game saving added to Settletopia

New Features
Game Saving is Here 
You can now save and load your game progress at any time.

Multiplayer-Compatible Saves 
Saved games work in both single-player and multiplayer modes.
Bug Fixes & Improvements
Game doesn't ask to input player name every time. Instead it is retrieved from Steam.

Fixed a bug where items would disappear when leaving and returning to a location.

Many internal improvements and cleanups that pave the way for smoother future updates and features.
Save Compatibility Notes
During development, older saves may become incompatible with newer versions. I’ll do my best to preserve compatibility — but no promises until we hit official release.
